text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.title: Inventory Tabs Config
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.ta: §eVertical§r: columns along the left and right of the screen. §eHorizontal§r: rows above and below the inventory (may not fit above very tall screens like large chests).
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.do: Check if block is in line of sight
If §cNo§r, you are able to click on inventories through walls
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.ro: Rotate the player to face the tab's block
If §aYes§r, the player will snap to position
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.on: Only show tabs for blocks with an inventory or menu
If §aYes§r, blocks that have a block entity but nothing to open (cables, belts, cogwheels, sculk catalysts...) get no tab. Blocks in the §nForce show§r list always get one.
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.ex: §nDo not show§r tabs for these blocks:
§nDo not show§r tabs on these screens:
Format: the screen's full class name, where §e*§r matches anything, e.g. §ecom.mrcrayfish.backpacked.*§r. A screen's parent classes count too.
text.autoconfig.inventory_tabs.option.de: Print debugging information (tab IDs added/removed) in the log
